items.prompt: A net position report says A 10, but includes no prices, fees or marks. What is established?

options.why: Shares and currency are different units, and no trade prices are provided.
The task has no cash or settlement data.

options.text: A signed position of 10 shares, not a monetary profit.
options.why: A positive net quantity alone does not determine realized or marked PnL.

options.text: Permission to submit an order for 10 more shares.
options.why: Aggregation is not an order instruction or trading authority.

items.explanation: A positive net quantity alone does not determine realized or marked PnL.
